'''Stand down, Beautiful Blaster''' was a verbal command that immediately shut down [[Nanna]], the [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]] assigned to care for [[Ben Skywalker]], the son of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade Skywalker]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> Mara Jade was forced to use the command after Ben lied to the droid about Mara intending to kill him once she discovered his secret of keeping a [[Gorog]], the secret nest of [[Killik]]s, inside his room.<ref name="JK" />
